sloka: यद्वा पुरेष्वयुक्तानि जना जनपदेषु च ।कुर्वते न च रक्षा ऽस्ति तदा कालकृतं भयम् ।। ७.७३.१७ ॥
transliteration: yadvā pureṣvayuktāni janā janapadeṣu ca ।kurvate na ca rakṣā 'sti tadā kālakṛtaṁ bhayam ।। 7.73.17 ॥

translations.english: Or when people commit improper acts in cities and districts, and there is no protection, then there is fear caused by the times.
